title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
title_zh: 超越联邦学习：面向自演化临床智能的去中心化智能体系统

paragraphs.en: arXivLabs is a framework that allows collaborators to develop and share new arXiv features directly on our website.
paragraphs.zh: arXivLabs 是一个框架，允许协作者直接在我们的网站上开发和分享新的 arXiv 功能。

paragraphs.en: Both individuals and organizations that work with arXivLabs have embraced and accepted our values of openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy. arXiv is committed to these values and only works with partners that adhere to them.
paragraphs.zh: 与 arXivLabs 合作的无论是个人还是组织，都认同并接受我们开放、社区、卓越和用户数据隐私的价值观。arXiv 致力于践行这些价值观，并仅与遵守这些价值观的合作伙伴开展合作。

paragraphs.en: Have an idea for a project that will add value for arXiv's community? Learn more about arXivLabs .
paragraphs.zh: 有一个能为 arXiv 社区增值的项目想法吗？ 了解更多关于 arXivLabs 的信息。
